title: Editing or removing a service asks first and spares enrolled assets
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as an Owner/Admin or as a user with "Settings Service" enabled.
  2. In the left sidebar under Settings, open the "Maintenance" entry beneath "Inspection Templates" (if the build shows "Maintenance schedules" instead, use that entry and record the label). Schedules are shared by the whole organization, whichever location is chosen in the header.
  3. Schedule "Highway Tractor PM" with PM-A (Every 3 months) and PM-B (Every 6 months), and PM-C covering PM-B (pick PM-B at "Services also covered"). Save.
  4. ↳ Open Customers, open a test customer (e.g. "Aacrest Works"), open its Assets tab and open an asset (e.g. unit 402 · 2019 Freightliner Cascadia).
  5. ↳ Open the asset's Maintenance tab (the last tab, after Notes) and click Enroll in Schedule.
  6. ↳ Pick the schedule (e.g. "Highway Tractor PM"), leave the last service dates blank unless the case says otherwise, and click Enroll.
custom_steps:
1. Click PM-A's row menu > Edit service, change the calendar to Every 4 months and click Save service; read the confirmation.
  2. Confirm with Save changes.
  3. Click PM-B's row menu > Remove service and read the confirmation; confirm.
  4. Open PM-C and read its canned lines; then open the enrolled asset's Maintenance tab.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A confirmation opens over the service editor naming the service: "Save changes to PM-A?" with "Assets already enrolled keep PM-A as it is." and "Assets enrolled from now on get the new version.".
  • The change saves.
  • The remove confirmation names the covering service: "PM-C covers PM-B. Removing PM-B takes it off PM-C; the lines already copied into PM-C stay."
  • PM-C keeps the lines copied from PM-B; the enrolled asset still shows PM-A every 3 months and still carries PM-B (nothing reaches already-enrolled assets, and nothing warns as though it would).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10563 (S6, Edit and archive a schedule), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S6 (Editing or removing a service; S6-R11, S6-N3); Design board "Chunk 1.dc.html" (MR V2 Claude Design project, version of 6 October 2026), artboards E04e, E04r; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R11: “Both ask for confirmation over the service editor, naming the service and the outcome: assets already enrolled are untouched, assets enrolled from now on get the schedule as it now stands”
  • Design board, artboard E04e: “Save changes to PM-A?”
  • S6-R11: “Removing a service that another covers names that service, for example PM-C covers PM-B. Removing PM-B takes it off PM-C; the lines already copied into PM-C stay”
  • S6-N3: “Removing a service never removes it from an asset already carrying it. There is no retroactive path, by design, and nothing warns as though there were”
